vuln.name: Spring Framework Known CVE
vuln.description: The detected Spring Framework or Spring Boot version is affected by a known vulnerability (such as Spring4Shell / CVE-2022-22965 class-binding or SpEL injection) based on fingerprinting.
vuln.impact: Depends on the specific CVE; ranges from remote code execution to data binding bypass.
vuln.recommendation: Upgrade Spring Framework / Spring Boot to a fixed version and apply relevant mitigations. Track the Spring security advisories.
